blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Tracking is how we know where a shipment is right now. Good tracking shows the location of every parcel, every truck, and every container, in real time.

Visibility is the bigger word. It means not just seeing the dot on the map, but knowing if a shipment will arrive on time, and if not, why. Customers love good tracking because it removes worry. Operations teams love it because they can react early.

Companies with strong visibility catch problems in hours, not days. A parcel you can see is a problem you can solve.

items.q: What does tracking show us?
options: Where a shipment is right now
items.why: "Tracking is how we know where a shipment is right now."

items.q: What is the difference between tracking and visibility?
options: Tracking shows the location; visibility also shows if it will arrive on time
items.why: Visibility é a palavra maior: não só o ponto no mapa, mas saber se vai chegar a tempo.

items.q: Why do customers love good tracking?
options: It is faster than a truck
It gives them a free gift
items.why: "Customers love good tracking because it removes worry."

items.q: The text says "A parcel you can see is a problem you can solve." This suggests that…
options: Seeing a parcel is a waste of time
You cannot help what you cannot see
items.why: Inferência: se ver ajuda a resolver, então o que você não vê é mais difícil de resolver.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Real-time tracking helps teams react early
It is fine to wait days to find a problem
Visibility helps catch problems in hours
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia quem acha o problema em horas, não em dias.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily mostrando a tela de rastreamento ao vivo para o novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team! Come and look at this big screen with me. This is our live tracking map of Europe. Do you see all these little dots?

Every dot is a shipment. Some dots are moving, some are stopped. A green dot is a shipment that is on time. A red dot is a shipment that is late, or that has a problem. Right now I can see two red dots near Paris. So I know we need to check them today, not tomorrow.

This is why tracking is so good. We can see where every parcel is, in real time. And when a customer calls to ask, "Where is my box?", we don't have to guess. We just look at the map and tell them.

My advice for you is simple. Watch the red dots. A red dot early in the day is a small problem. A red dot at the end of the day is an angry customer. So we react early. Every dot is a promise to a customer, and we want to keep it.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Emily showing the new colleague?
options: A live tracking map of Europe
items.why: "This is our live tracking map of Europe."

items.q: What does a red dot mean?
options: The shipment is late or has a problem
items.why: "A red dot is a shipment that is late, or that has a problem."

items.q: What does Emily do when she sees the two red dots near Paris?
options: She calls the customer to say goodbye
She checks them today, not tomorrow
items.why: "I know we need to check them today, not tomorrow."

items.q: Emily says a red dot early in the day is a small problem. This suggests that…
options: The morning is a bad time to work
Red dots are never a problem
items.why: Inferência: cedo é problema pequeno, tarde vira cliente irritado — esperar piora.

items.q: Why does Emily say "every dot is a promise to a customer"?
options: Because each shipment matters to a real person
Because the dots are only colours
Because customers do not like dots
items.why: Inferência: cada ponto é um pedido real que a empresa quer entregar bem.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We can see the parcel in real time." Real time means…
items.why: Real time = tempo real: você vê no momento em que acontece.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Good tracking removes the customer's ___."
items.why: Worry = preocupação, o que o bom rastreamento tira do cliente.

items.q: "The map shows the location of every truck." Location means…
items.why: Location = localização: o lugar onde a coisa está.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When we see a problem, we ___ early instead of waiting."
items.why: To react = reagir: agir quando vê o problema.

items.q: "Companies with strong visibility catch problems fast." Strong here means…
items.why: Strong = forte, aqui no sentido de bom e confiável.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem no dia a dia da logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's keep an eye on the red dots." To keep an eye on means to…
items.why: Keep an eye on = ficar de olho, observar com atenção.

items.q: "The truck is held up in traffic." Held up means…
items.why: Held up = atrasado, parado por algum motivo.

items.q: "Please follow up with the customer about the late parcel." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar sequência, voltar a falar para atualizar.

items.q: "We need to sort out the problem before the end of the day." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, arrumar o problema.

items.q: "The shipment will show up on the map soon." To show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, surgir na tela.
